notes.title: [Store page published] Add Cross
notes.notes:
On September 5, 2025, we launched the store page for a game called "Add Cross." 

Write the numbers 1 through 9 one by one without repeating them, and add them all up to get the number in the puzzle square! This is a quick and easy pencil puzzle game.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44047080/e1374123f05afc59baea31bdd8999781cb328e01.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3899090/_/

notes.title: Available from 7/14! Gunma's Ambition -You and me are Gunma- Reiwa 2nd national census edition [Launch Sale 10% Off]
notes.notes:
On July 14, 2025, we began distributing "Gunma's Ambition -You and me are Gunma- Reiwa 2nd national census edition".
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3119260/__2/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3119260/__2/[/url]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44047080/d99ca29524eee4197b731bdcb0ba759eee839cc0.png[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44047080/cf575b5d182a633356084474d37cb72308ff1b92.png[/img]


[h1]* What is"Gunma's Ambition"[/h1]
You are Gunma Prefecture. This is a game where you use the population of cities and towns in Gunma Prefecture to turn other prefectures into Gunma Prefectures.

* [ 10% Sale ] For two weeks from today, we will be holding a 10% sale from July 14th to July 27th (28th in some areas). Take this opportunity to enjoy Gunma Prefecture.

[b]USD  $3.99 -> $3.59[/b]


[h1]Soundtrack will be released soon![/h1]
The background music for "Gunma's Ambition -You and me are Gunma- Reiwa 2nd national census edition" and arranged songs from "Sudoku Relax 4" will be released as soundtrack!
